page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with brace diagrams inside the text block. No marginal notes. Running head at top, page number above it, catchword and gathering signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Quæ in ecclesiasticis muneribus aucta sunt, est administrorum distributio, ut per singula sabbatha vices suas quas sorte obtinuerunt implerent. 1.Cro. 24.1.2.5.2.Cro.8.26.
Vices autem omnibus & seorsim & coniunctim designatæ erant viginti quatuor. 1.Cro.23. & 24. & 25.& 26.
main_text.l: Eorum qui diuturnum officium in templo implebant:
Qui diuturnum officium in templo implebant erant
main_text.p: Sacerdotibus administrantes erant qui tentorij, & omnis rei sanctæ observationem observabant. 1.Cro.23.26.31.
Musici sacri sunt, qui ad cuiusq; generis instrumenta sacra musica prophetabant, siue sacras cantiones canebant. 1.Cro.25.1.2.3.4.5.

page.notes: Printed text is in a mix of long-s and round-s forms; transcribed as plain s. The brace diagrams are rendered as outline lines. The left edge fragments of the neighbouring page are not transcribed.
